reason: The Please enter one or more email addresses message sits in a red banner div that carries role=alert itself; the ax probe reads it as alert, live=assertive, with the error text inside, and the banner is on screen above the form. The sweep flagged it because no live region existed before the banner was inserted, but an element that arrives with role=alert is announced on insertion, which is the ARIA19 technique for 4.1.3.
criterionAnalysis: 4.1.3 Status Messages (AA) needs the message to be programmatically determinable through role or properties so assistive technology announces it without focus; the banner has role=alert (ARIA19), so it meets the criterion even though the container did not exist before the error. 3.3.1 Error Identification passes: the error is described in text (Please enter one or more email addresses) in a visible banner. 4.1.2 does not fail: the alert has a role and the text is its content. The sweep's pre-existing-region test is stricter than what AA asks of a role=alert element.
